margin-bottom: 0.4rem; } .wp-block-post-comments-form input:not([type=submit]):not([type=checkbox]), .wp-block-post-comments-form textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
